machine: Apple M1 Max, 32 GB unified memory

case.prompt: A blue ceramic teapot on a windowsill.

method.process: Both requests execute sequentially in one native process.
method.reused: Parsed tokenizer vocabulary, BPE merge ranks, and Unicode regular expression.
method.phase_scoped: Text encoder, packed transformer, and VAE mappings and Metal resources are released at their existing phase boundaries.
method.reason: Establish the benefit of safe process/tokenizer reuse before attempting to overlap weight mappings whose combined working set exceeds 32 GB.

interpretation: Process and tokenizer reuse alone provide no measurable warm-request speedup. The sequential 17.5 GB text, 12.42 GiB transformer, and 1.35 GB VAE phases churn the 32 GB unified-memory page cache; meaningful resident-mode gains require a much smaller text checkpoint or a different memory policy.
